extracted.name: Almond Strawberry Chia Seed Pudding
extracted.description: This is a very quick pudding recipe with chia seeds, almond milk, and fresh strawberries, requiring no cooking and no fuss!
instruction_lines: Puree almond milk and strawberries in a blender until smooth; pour into a bowl. Stir chia seeds, honey, and vanilla extract into the strawberry puree.
Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate until set, about 4 hours.
